title: The Champ: between the original events
integration: Standalone anthology prototype with brief time/location cards; future native campaign insertion must yield to untouched original events at these anchors.

stages.window: During Fei's unconscious recovery, before the native awakening/summons.
preceding_canonical_anchors: field234 dialogue20: existing transfer order to D Block (not Rico's knowledge).
following_canonical_anchors: field213 dialogue26-30 and218 dialogue2-10: unchanged summons/introduction.
stages.emotional_change: Rico refuses to assign a rank without a fight. Suzarn accepts his competitive standard rather than receiving a sentimental favor.

stages.window: After the complete native Baptism, whichever rank outcome the player earned.
preceding_canonical_anchors: field199 native Baptism and its existing rank branches finish.
following_canonical_anchors: Fei's original preparation/early Battling progression and explosion proceed unchanged.
stages.emotional_change: Suzarn wants to win freedom on her own strength. Rico recognizes a possible rival, not merely a subordinate.

stages.window: After the fifth death becomes known, before Rico's original visit to Fei.
preceding_canonical_anchors: field196 dialogue139 is the earlier fourth-victim notice.
field211 dialogue70 identifies Suzarn as fifth victim.
following_canonical_anchors: field213 dialogue78-97: untouched apology, suspicion, recruitment and readiness choice.
stages.emotional_change: Suzarn's unfulfilled ambition exposes what strength failed to secure. Rico elects to approach Fei himself; the original apology and investigation remain ahead.

stages.window: After the original sewer return, care/reunion and rivalry discussion have completed.
preceding_canonical_anchors: field239 dialogue17: Fei notices the left-arm wound.
field211 dialogue178-201: original return/reunion, injury concern and end of alliance.
following_canonical_anchors: Original remaining Fei tournament progression and Finals.
stages.emotional_change: In private, the wounded Rico fears showing weakness to the opponent who offered concern. His public challenge is not replayed.

stages.window: After the native Finals result and Rico's dismissal of his followers, before the Group League.
preceding_canonical_anchors: field221 dialogue154-159: wound is no excuse, Fei is Champion, Rico leaves and forbids followers.
following_canonical_anchors: Group League incident as recounted by field218 dialogue35.
Rue's later room handover remains at field218 dialogue13-35, in its original chronology.
stages.emotional_change: Loss prompts an unanswered question about the pardon he once refused. This does not establish the canonical reason for his refusal.

stages.window: Immediately before Rico returns for the already-established Group League appearance.
preceding_canonical_anchors: Original post-Finals departure in field221 dialogue157-159.
following_canonical_anchors: Unchanged Group League incident, later recounted by Rue at field218 dialogue35.
Original search, Central District entry and later locked-room material retain their order.
stages.emotional_change: His established resentment over the expulsion remains after the title is gone. No family connection, plan or new motive is disclosed.
